__path.description: Workspace-relative path of the artifact file, injected by the orchestration harness (not authored in frontmatter).

__kind.description: Artifact-kind discriminator injected by the harness; must equal x-artifact.kind.

__artifact_id.description: Stable artifact id injected by the harness, derived from the file and frontmatter.

__frontmatter_present.description: Harness assertion that YAML frontmatter was found and parsed; always true for a valid artifact.

__sections.description: Artifact body sections keyed by their `## ` heading — one property per template section; the value is the raw Markdown under that heading. Authored artifacts may add or omit sections, so this is advisory (additionalProperties is permitted) and no section is individually required.

Prioritized Story List.description: Pair convention: first-named = initial Driver, second-named = initial Navigator. Roles swap each pair-programming micro-cycle (see SKILL.md § Pair Programming).

What's NOT in This Sprint.description: `What's NOT in This Sprint` section of the artifact body.

RTE Dispatch Prompt.description: `RTE Dispatch Prompt` section of the artifact body.

Story Status.description: `Story Status` section of the artifact body.

Bugs Found.description: `Bugs Found` section of the artifact body.

Notes.description: [Free-form notes about decisions, ADR amendments needed, context for recovery]

Manual Setup Required.description: [Any env vars, config, or manual steps needed]

Stories Accepted.description: `Stories Accepted` section of the artifact body.

Blockers.description: NONE (or: list of GitHub Issues with severity:blocker)

Result.description: ✅ PASS — No blockers. Sprint N ready to open PR for the ★ PR Gate. (or: ❌ HOLD — blockers must clear before the ★ PR Gate)

Burn-down.description: `Burn-down` section of the artifact body (merged in from the former progress artifact kind).

Story status snapshot.description: `Story status snapshot` section of the artifact body (merged in from the former progress artifact kind).

Open blockers.description: (Roll-up from daily stand-up inputs; merged in from the former progress artifact kind).

Gate decision backlog.description: (Roll-up from unresolved gate decisions; unresolved entries must be included in every gate packet; merged in from the former progress artifact kind).

Done this sprint.description: `Done this sprint` section of the artifact body (merged in from the former progress artifact kind).

Notes / scope changes.description: Append-only log of mid-sprint clarifications (PO-confirmed); merged in from the former progress artifact kind.

__body.description: Raw Markdown body of the artifact (everything after the frontmatter), injected by the harness.

workItemRelations.description: Typed work-item relations (dependsOn / enables / relatedTo / supersedes).

wsjf.description: Weighted Shortest Job First scoring block.

risk.description: Risk level — the consequence of being wrong: low | medium | critical.

complexity.description: Complexity — cognitive/structural difficulty: simple | involved | complex.

openItems.description: Clarification + challenge ledger (a blocking open entry halts the relevant gate).

cost.description: Token-cost accounting block (see the cost definition).

github.description: GitHub Projects sync envelope, filled by portfolio/_sync (null when authoring).

sources.description: Derivation provenance (narrowed subtype of the base contract's sources): refs to the upstream artifact(s) this plan was built from. Allowed source kinds: story, story-enabler.
